seoTitle: Video Sitemap Generator with Required Field Checks
metaDescription: Create a video sitemap with thumbnail, title, description and content or player URL. Checks Google limits first. Free.
intro: Builds a video sitemap from simple key: value blocks and checks the required fields.
why:
A video sitemap lets search engines find videos on a page. Missing required fields or out-of-range values make an entry useless.

This tool checks the fields Google documents: thumbnail, title, description of up to 2048 characters, a content or player URL, duration from 1 to 28800 seconds, rating 0 to 5 and at most 32 tags. It stops with a list of problems instead of writing a broken file.
howTo: Write one block per video, separated by a blank line.
Fill page, thumbnail, title, description and content or player.
Add optional fields such as duration or published.
Copy the XML into your sitemap file.

faq.a: At least one is required. Content is recommended when you have it.
W3C: 2026-05-01 or with time and zone.
No. Add them by hand if needed.

faq.q: Can one page have several videos?
faq.a: Yes. Repeat the same page value.
